anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, large-radius convex arc transitioning smoothly into the dorsal ridge.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with high-intensity light reflectance at the anterior-most tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle measured at the transition between the descending melon slope and the horizontal rostrum plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced depigmentation or high-luminance patch visible along the oral commissure and rostrum terminus.
